text:
For each level, the natural width (energy uncertainty) is obtained from the time-energy uncertainty relation  
ΔE · Δt ≈ ħ/2.

ħ = 6.58 × 10⁻¹⁶ eV·s.

Level 1: τ₁ = 10⁻⁹ s  
ΔE₁ ≈ ħ/(2τ₁) ≈ (6.58 × 10⁻¹⁶)/(2 × 10⁻⁹) ≈ 3 × 10⁻⁷ eV.

Level 2: τ₂ = 10⁻⁸ s  
ΔE₂ ≈ ħ/(2τ₂) ≈ (6.58 × 10⁻¹⁶)/(2 × 10⁻⁸) ≈ 3 × 10⁻⁸ eV.

To resolve two lines their separation should exceed the sum (or at least be of the same order) of their widths:  
ΔE_required ≳ ΔE₁ + ΔE₂ ≈ 3 × 10⁻⁷ eV + 3 × 10⁻⁸ eV ≈ 3 × 10⁻⁷ – 10⁻⁶ eV.

Among the given choices, only 10⁻⁴ eV is comfortably larger than this, so it will allow clear resolution of the two energy levels.

Answer: B
